How to use this section

Technology coverage on Xenors focuses on practical changes that affect developers, website owners and everyday users. Topics include web development, cybersecurity, search, passkeys, AI-enabled products and the software patterns behind modern applications.

A useful technology guide should explain both the feature and the trade-off. Faster development can introduce maintenance risk. Better personalization can raise privacy questions. New authentication methods can improve security while requiring a migration plan. The articles in this section try to keep those relationships visible.

Use this hub to move from current stories into deeper coding and implementation material. When a topic requires exact syntax or product limits, follow the linked documentation and tutorial pages.
